title: Universal Guidance for Diffusion Models
property: any differentiable off-the-shelf criterion: CLIP match, segmentation, identity, detection, style
reads: Off-the-shelf network reads the one-step clean estimate z0_hat, decoded to an image on Stable Diffusion
trained_on: nothing trained; pre-trained guidance networks with hand-written losses, frozen diffusion model
gradient_enters: Forward: eps_hat = eps + s(t) grad_zt loss(c, f(z0_hat)); backward: eps_tilde = eps - sqrt(alpha_t/(1-alpha_t)) Delta_z0; each step repeats k times by re-noising z_{t-1} to level t
unseen: no: guidance networks are used as supplied and no category is held out
headline: No quantitative metric or baseline score is reported; qualitative Stable Diffusion results use segmentation at s(t) = 400 sqrt(1-alpha_t), k = 10 and detection at s(t) = 100 sqrt(1-alpha_t), k = 3, both with m = 0
copy_or_avoid: Copy self-recurrence as the next test of our decoded-image checker; avoid assuming z0_hat is readable at early steps, which this paper never measures and our 0.50 balanced accuracy contradicts (inferred)
model: Stable Diffusion (version not printed) / unconditional ImageNet diffusion
